'''Mr. Hummingbird''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game.

==Debut Appearance==
As an NPC character, Mr. Hummingbird first appears in the Festive Event, [[A Colorful Hunt]].

==History==
Mr. Hummingbird informs {{c|Carrol}} of a "strange bunny-thing" known as {{c|Cotton}}. He is not known to appear in the events that follow.

==Trivia==
*Despite appearing in A Colorful Hunt, Mr. Hummingbird does not have any artwork.
